LanguageData.MXZL_ZhaoliDeathFieldActive.label: <color=#E85A7A>Deathflow Field</color>
LanguageData.MXZL_ZhaoliDeathFieldActive.description: <color=#E85A7A>Zhaoli</color>'s sustained <color=#E85A7A>Deathflow Field</color> continuously applies Death Sentence to every unit in range except herself. Death Sentence accumulation decays rapidly after a target leaves the field.
LanguageData.MXZL_ZhaoliDormancy.label: <color=#C77DFF>All Things Impermanent: Dormancy</color>
LanguageData.MXZL_ZhaoliDormancy.description: Forced <color=#C77DFF>dormancy</color> caused by overflowing karma. <color=#E85A7A>Zhaoli</color> remains asleep and cannot act normally until she wakes naturally after thirty days.
LanguageData.MXZL_ZhaoliKarma.label: <color=#E85A7A>Karma</color>
LanguageData.MXZL_ZhaoliKarma.description: <color=#E85A7A>Zhaoli</color>'s special resource. It is gained through <color=#C77DFF>death pronouncement</color> executions and spent by active abilities. This hediff also records current <color=#D66BFF>Karma Links</color>.
LanguageData.MXZL_ZhaoliKarma.comps.0.resourceDescrip: <color=#E85A7A>Zhaoli</color>'s special resource. Each successful <color=#C77DFF>death pronouncement</color> grants Karma, and active abilities spend it. When this resource exceeds <color=#E85A7A>100</color>, overflow is first shared with linked targets.
LanguageData.MXZL_ZhaoliKarmaLink.label: <color=#E85A7A>Karma Linked</color>
LanguageData.MXZL_ZhaoliKarmaLink.description: This target has formed a <color=#D66BFF>Karma Link</color> with <color=#E85A7A>Zhaoli</color>. The link lasts 30 days. During this time, it can carry Zhaoli's overflowing karma or die in her place when she would die.
LanguageData.MXZL_ZhaoliOverflowKarma.label: <color=#B86CFF>Karmic Burden</color>
LanguageData.MXZL_ZhaoliOverflowKarma.description: This target is carrying one layer of overflowing <color=#B86CFF>Karma</color> for <color=#E85A7A>Zhaoli</color>. Until this layer fades, it cannot carry another new overflow for her.
LanguageData.MXZL_ZhaoliMinghuo.label: <color=#FF6A6A>Netherflame Armament</color>
LanguageData.MXZL_ZhaoliMinghuo.description: <color=#E85A7A>Netherflame</color> and dead karma are bound to Zhaoli's weapon. While enchanted, the bound weapon's damage, armor penetration, accuracy, and attack speed are raised to <color=#FF6A6A>1.5x</color>, range increases by 2 cells, and melee hits add <color=#FF8A66>flame damage</color>.
LanguageData.MXZL_ZhaoliMinshenSlow.label: <color=#C77DFF>Mind-Effacement Suppression</color>
LanguageData.MXZL_ZhaoliMinshenSlow.description: <color=#C77DFF>Mind-Effacement</color> suppresses this target's ability to move, reducing movement speed to 20%.
LanguageData.MXZL_ZhaoliMinshenDamage.label: <color=#E85A7A>Mind-Effacement Erosion</color>
LanguageData.MXZL_ZhaoliMinshenDamage.description: <color=#E85A7A>Mind-Effacement</color> eats away at the target's life, dealing 1 armor-ignoring blunt damage to the torso each second for 5 seconds.
LanguageData.MXZL_ZhaoliRebirth.label: <color=#D9574E>Return of the Dead</color>
LanguageData.MXZL_ZhaoliRebirth.description: <color=#E85A7A>Zhaoli</color>'s death is temporarily accepted. After death, her corpse disappears, and she returns at a random position in the player's base <color=#C77DFF>ten days later</color>.
LanguageData.MXZL_ZhaoliDingshuMark.label: <color=#C9A2FF>Fixed Fate Mark</color>
LanguageData.MXZL_ZhaoliDingshuMark.description: This target was dragged back to life by Zhaoli through <color=#C9A2FF>Fixed Fate</color>. If it dies again while the mark lasts, it cannot be resurrected again.
LanguageData.MXZL_ZhaoliHideoutState.label: Zhaoli Hideout State
LanguageData.MXZL_ZhaoliHideoutState.description: Temporary state used at Zhaoli's story hideout, keeping her in place while she waits for interaction.
LanguageData.MXZL_ZhaoliRaidState.label: Zhaoli Raid State
LanguageData.MXZL_ZhaoliRaidState.description: Temporary state used when hostile Zhaoli raids the colony. Records phase, hatred, transition, and raid behavior.
LanguageData.MXZL_ZhaoliShieldLayers.label: <color=#D66BFF>Deathward Shield</color>
LanguageData.MXZL_ZhaoliShieldLayers.description: Each time Zhaoli absorbs a unit through <color=#E85A7A>death pronouncement</color>, she gains 5 layers of <color=#B86CFF>Deathward Shield</color>. The shield negates one instance of damage and consumes 1 layer when hit. Damage over time also consumes layers each time it takes effect.
